name: Snap Pea Salad With Mint and Tahini-Harissa Dressing

ingredients.name: snap peas, ends and strings pulled off

instructions.primary_message: Bring a large saucepan of heavily salted water to a boil and prepare an ice bath. Add snap peas and boil until crisp-tender, about 2 minutes. Using a slotted spoon or mesh strainer, transfer snap peas to ice bath to chill.

Combine garlic and 1 tablespoon lemon juice in a mini chopper or blender. Blend until garlic is finely minced. Add tahini, yogurt, harissa, and 1 tablespoon olive oil and blend to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Set aside.

Whisk together remaining 1 tablespoon lemon juice, lemon zest, shallot, mint, and remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large bowl. Drain snap peas and dry carefully in a salad spinner or on a paper towel-lined tray. Add to bowl with dressing and toss thoroughly to coat. Transfer to a serving platter and drizzle with harissa-tahini sauce. Sprinkle with chili flakes. Serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: easy, harissa, mint, quick, salad, snap pea, Tahini, yogurt

description: Sweet snap peas and mint is a classic combination that lends itself well to variation. Here we riff on it by adding yogurt and a couple other flavorful ingredients like tahini and harissa. It's light yet rich, cooling yet spicy.
notes: Optional or for serving: Piment d'espelette, crushed Aleppo chiles, gochugaru (Korean chile flakes), or other crushed red pepper flakes, for serving
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
